description: D1 screen panel subset: 100 concepts (90 MAIN, 10 SENSITIVITY-only), seeded sample. Each example = one concept with its per-(concept, t) W1 features + openness (feature_rows), W2 outcomes (outcome_rows) and its E_up label (onset/group, null if never E_up).

rowcount_decision.F3_rule: if complete-case closure_res leaves < 150 screen MAIN concepts or < 500 rows -> closure_res_imp co-primary
rowcount_decision.coprimary_rule: D1_SUPPORTED_SCREEN requires the pre-declared rule to hold for closure_res AND for closure_res_imp on the same outcome (conservative conjunction; no forking)
rowcount_decision.F4_rule: if n* < 20 in > 40% of MAIN rows -> Y1r floor 10 and Y1r20 -> Y1r10
